title: "Quick Reference"

## Core Data Model Classes

The most important classes for specifying and running a simulation:

| Class | Purpose | Data Model | API |
|-------|---------|-----------|-----|
| `SimulationExperiment` | Top-level experiment specification | [schema](datamodel/classes/SimulationExperiment.qmd) | [api](api/experiment.qmd) |
| `Dynamics` | Neural mass model (ODE / rate equations) | [schema](datamodel/classes/Dynamics.qmd) | [api](api/localdynamics.qmd) |
| `Network` | Brain network (nodes, weights, delays) | [schema](datamodel/classes/Network.qmd) | [api](api/network.qmd) |
| `Connectome` | Structural connectivity matrix + tracts | [schema](datamodel/classes/Connectome.qmd) | [api](api/connectomes.qmd) |
| `Coupling` | Inter-node coupling function | [schema](datamodel/classes/Coupling.qmd) | — |
| `Integrator` | Numerical integrator (Euler, Heun, …) | [schema](datamodel/classes/Integrator.qmd) | [api](api/integration.qmd) |
| `Noise` | Stochastic noise specification | [schema](datamodel/classes/Noise.qmd) | [api](api/integration.qmd) |
| `ObservationModel` | Maps state variables to observables | [schema](datamodel/classes/ObservationModel.qmd) | [api](api/observation.qmd) |
| `Parameter` | Model parameter with units + shape | [schema](datamodel/classes/Parameter.qmd) | — |
| `StateVariable` | ODE state variable definition | [schema](datamodel/classes/StateVariable.qmd) | — |
| `LossFunction` | Symbolic loss for model fitting | [schema](datamodel/classes/LossFunction.qmd) | — |
| `ModelFitting` | Fitting / optimization specification | [schema](datamodel/classes/ModelFitting.qmd) | — |
| `Exploration` | Parameter exploration specification | [schema](datamodel/classes/Exploration.qmd) | — |
| `Algorithm` | Iterative tuning algorithm (FIC, …) | [schema](datamodel/classes/Algorithm.qmd) | — |
| `Stimulus` | Stimulation / perturbation protocol | [schema](datamodel/classes/Stimulus.qmd) | — |
| `Event` | Discrete event during simulation | [schema](datamodel/classes/Event.qmd) | — |

## Key API Entry Points

The most commonly called functions and classes:

| Module | What it provides |
|--------|-----------------|
| [experiment](api/experiment.qmd) | `SimulationExperiment` — load, configure, run, and render code |
| [localdynamics](api/localdynamics.qmd) | `Dynamics` — load neural mass models from YAML / ontology |
| [network](api/network_api.qmd) | Network construction helpers and I/O |
| [integration](api/integration.qmd) | `Integrator` and `Noise` runtime classes |
| [observation](api/observation.qmd) | Observation model utilities |
| [connectomes](api/connectomes.qmd) | Load / browse structural connectomes |
| [code](api/code.qmd) | Code generation (JAX, Julia, …) |
| [main](api/main.qmd) | REST API (`RunExperimentRequest`, `RunExperimentResponse`) |
| [bifurcation](api/bifurcation.qmd) | Bifurcation analysis result containers |
| [analysis](api/analysis.qmd) | Simulation analysis utilities |

## Typical Workflow

```python
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment

# 1. Load experiment from YAML
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("database/studies/Schirner2023.yaml")

# 2. Run
result = exp.run()

# 3. Inspect
result.plot()
result.integration.observations.bold   # BOLD time series
result.algorithms.fic.state            # FIC-tuned state

# 4. Generate code for a backend
print(exp.render_code("jax"))          # JAX/tvboptim
print(exp.render_code("networkdynamics-julia"))
```
